# ProductTally

> Independent, evidence-led notes on SaaS, software, and digital products for creators and small teams.

ProductTally publishes practical product observations, comparisons, and guides. Each product page states the tasks checked, known limits, and official sources. Basic tests cover only the described tasks; they are not a review of every feature.

## Editorial principles
- Separate observed results from features not tested.
- Prefer official product documentation as a source.
- Product links point to official websites.
